'''Moldaver's elite guards''' are two [[New California Republic]] soldiers under personal command of [[Lee Moldaver]] {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
These two guards are [[New California Republic]] soldiers. In [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]], they are stationed at the [[Griffith Observatory]] under the command of [[Lee Moldaver]], who leads the NCR forces in the [[Los Angeles]] region.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The End (episode)|The End]]===
Led by [[Lee Moldaver]], together with [[Vault 32 raider|a group of raiders]], they infiltrated [[Vault 32]] (whose original inhabitants had died by this point) from the outside circa [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]]. Disguised as Vault 32 dwellers, they entered [[Vault 33]] during the Triennial Trade. 

While the raiders wreaked havoc in the Vault, Moldaver and her guards took several hostages, with the guards holding them at gunpoint. After Moldaver accomplished her objective (kidnapping the Vault 33 overseer, [[Hank MacLean]]), she left with her elite guards and a few of the raiders.

===[[The Beginning]]===
The elite guards stop [[Lucy MacLean]] on her way to the Griffith Observatory and lead her to Moldaver. 

When the observatory is attacked by [[Brotherhood of Steel]] forces, the elite guards participate in the [[Battle of Griffith Observatory]].

==Appearances==
Moldaver's elite guards appear only {{In|FOTV}}.
{{FOTV appearances|1=101|8=108}}

==Behind the scenes==
While [[Aixa Kendrick]] was initially credited in this role in the Internet Movie Database, she received no credit for the appearance in the actual episodes. The other guard is portrayed by an uncredited background performer.
